title: Map of Loudoun County, Virginia (Yardley Taylor)
attribution: Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division, G3883.L5G46 1854 .T3, digital id g3883l la001287
notes: Surveyed by Yardley Taylor, a Loudoun Quaker surveyor; published Philadelphia by Thomas Reynolds & Robert Pearsall Smith, c.1854, "Edition A". Shows magisterial districts and names of residents. Insets of Leesburg, Middleburg and Waterford, plus a geological profile and elevation list. Serve as tiles with OpenSeadragon or Leaflet-IIIF - do not bundle the raster.
